topics.topic: How the imported runtime value selects the cryptography hash algorithm despite bans on named hash classes and reflection
questions: The hash constructor cannot be selected from the runtime string without either naming hash classes in code or reflectively discovering/accessing one; which prohibition must change, or must IMPORTS provide a non-reflective hash-constructor factory or mapping?

Must the hash algorithm be selected through an explicitly imported or explicitly named cryptography hash class, removing the ban on hash names written in code, or must reflective name-to-class selection be permitted and specified?

Replace the class-construction and name-comparison procedure with a behavioral requirement that the imported constant selects the cryptography hash algorithm, leaving the implementation mechanics out of the note.

quotes: _encrypt_backup: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST seal under an AES-GCM key of the imported BACKUP_KEY_BYTES constant in bytes, derived by HKDF with the hash of the cryptography package whose name equals the one the imported BACKUP_KEY_DERIVATION_HASH constant holds, the hash built by its class and its name compared with the constant, never chosen through hash names written in the code, and no salt from the bytes of backup_key with those of the imported BACKUP_KEY_DERIVATION_INFO constant as its info, both encoded by the imported TEXT_ENCODING constant, using the cryptography package, and MUST pass the record line's bytes without its line feed as the associated data, so that a changed record fails the decryption.
judgement.why: The note prescribes the hash-class construction and comparison procedure instead of stating only the required selection behavior.

author_guidance: Before editing, identify the decision's owning state from the phase purpose, question_scope and layer obligations, then choose a disposition for each topic that awaits one.
fixed: repair a decision the owning state must make; do not add later-layer implementation choices merely to close a topic. Record the fix commit and review the changed text once.

carried: name the receiving layer and use --what to preserve the choice, its options and consequences, and the required guarantee every option must keep. Decide any guarantee owned here before carrying its execution onward.
accepted: explain why the remaining choice is permitted. Bring an unresolved product choice to the owner with its options and consequences; absence of a quoted requirement does not decide it.
contradiction and standard_violation take no disposition: repair the offending text in its owning state and review the change. Deterministic transition findings must also close through their checks.
